source_population: In-scope posted synthetic loan principal events (DISBURSEMENT and PRINCIPAL_REPAYMENT after matched-pair reversal removal) for the business date from extracts/loan_event_sample.csv
target_population: Synthetic general ledger extract lines for the same business date, same event scope and reversal handling
grain: one comparison row per loan account per currency per business date

time_context.late_arrival_rule: Example assumption (EVD-0009, not bank policy): events posted after the cutoff are held in a late-arrival bucket and reconciled in the next cycle; bank late-arrival policy is still to be supplied

currency_controls.conversion_rule: not converted - monetary controls compare within each currency and results remain partitioned by currency_code; the FX conversion policy is unresolved (EVD-0005), so no rate or base currency is applied

controls.description: Compare in-scope posted principal event counts against ledger line counts within each currency, also split by branch_code.
Compare net signed principal event amounts against ledger amounts within each currency; no conversion is applied (EVD-0005).
Confirm matched original-reversal pairs are excluded exactly once from both source and target totals, per currency.

exception_management.workflow: Log each exception in the project exception tracker with the comparison extract attached and resolve before human validation.
exception_management.evidence_retention: Retain comparison extracts and exception logs in the project archive for this example.
